```python
def grid_path(n, sx, sy, ex, ey, bx, by):
    # Recompute Manhattan distance formula since we have restricted move directions
    # from (sx, sy) to (ex, ey) excluding (bx, by) location
    def distance(x1, y1, x2, y2):
        return abs(x1 - x2) + abs(y1 - y2)
    return min(distance(sx, sy, ex, ey) + distance(ex, ey, bx, by),
               distance(sx, sy, bx, by) + distance(bx, by, ex, ey),
               distance(sx, sy, ex, ey) + distance(bx, by, ex, ey))
```
